```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(vegan)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

source("colors_2026b.R")

meta_file <- "../new_data_2026b/full_meta_full.csv.gz"   # meta.data of the full atlas object
obj_file  <- "../new_data_2026b/Objects/full Dataset/final_Subtyping_iCNV_reclustered.qs2"  # read only to compute a missing matrix
cache_dir <- "../GloScope_Full_Outputs_2026b"            # divergence matrices, computed once
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

N_PERM <- 999
LOC3 <- c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body")
CALLED <- c("BAP1", "SF3B1", "EIF1AX")
DRIVERS <- c("GNAQ", "GNA11", "PLCB4")
```

```{r metadata}
cells <- data.table::fread(meta_file, data.table = FALSE,
                           select = c("cell", "Sample", "Patient_nr", "samplename", "location", "origin", "organ",
                                      "primary_mutation", "secondary_mutation", "majority_celltype", "Malignant",
                                      "Gender", "Age_atDiagnosisY"))
stopifnot(nrow(cells) == 349696, n_distinct(cells$Sample) == 63)

# Melanocytic cells = annotated melanocytes + melanoma cells. In tumours these are exactly the iCNV-malignant
# cells, in non-malignant samples the healthy melanocytes, so one matrix serves both cell sets.
cells$melanocytic <- cells$majority_celltype %in% c("Melanocytes", "Melanoma cells")
tum <- cells$origin != "non-malignant"
stopifnot(all(cells$melanocytic[tum] == (cells$Malignant[tum] == "Malignant")),
          !any(cells$Malignant[!tum] == "Malignant"))

age_bin <- function(x) as.character(cut(x, c(-Inf, 40, 60, Inf), c("<40", "40-60", "≥60"), right = FALSE))
sm <- cells %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Patient_nr, samplename, location, origin, organ, primary_mutation, secondary_mutation, Gender), first),
            age = as.numeric(first(Age_atDiagnosisY)), n_cells = n(), n_mel = sum(melanocytic), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Patient_nr) %>%
  # age is a patient attribute: non-malignant samples carry none at sample level and take their patient's age
  mutate(age_group = age_bin(age), age_group_pt = age_bin(first(na.omit(age)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(origin = factor(origin, levels = c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis"))) %>%
  arrange(origin, organ, Sample)
```

```{r divergence}
# GloScope on the uncorrected PCA (50 PCs): k-NN density (k = 50) per sample, symmetric KL divergence per pair.
# Entry (i, j) depends only on the cells of samples i and j, so every test below uses a sub-matrix of one of two
# matrices: all cells (63 samples) and melanocytic cells (62 samples with >= 50 melanocytic cells).
divergence <- function(file, use_cell, min_cells) {
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, file)
  if (file.exists(f)) return(qs2::qs_read(f, nthreads = 1))
  obj <- qs2::qs_read(obj_file, nthreads = 1)
  keep <- colnames(obj)[colnames(obj) %in% cells$cell[use_cell]]
  smp <- obj@meta.data[keep, "Sample"]
  keep <- keep[smp %in% names(which(table(smp) >= min_cells))]
  d <- GloScope::gloscope(SeuratObject::Embeddings(obj, "pca")[keep, 1:50], obj@meta.data[keep, "Sample"],
                          dens = "KNN", dist_mat = "KL", k = 50,
                          BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 24))
  qs2::qs_save(d, f, nthreads = 1)
  d
}
D_all <- divergence("divergence_origin_full_cohort.qs2", rep(TRUE, nrow(cells)), 1)
D_mel <- divergence("divergence_gender_melanocytic.qs2", cells$melanocytic, 50)
stopifnot(setequal(rownames(D_all), sm$Sample), setequal(rownames(D_mel), sm$Sample[sm$n_mel >= 50]))
```

```{r anosim}
sets <- with(sm, list(
  all       = Sample,
  pUM       = Sample[origin == "primary"],
  nm        = Sample[origin == "non-malignant"],
  nm_pUM    = Sample[origin != "metastasis"],
  no_cc     = Sample[location != "ciliochoroidal"],
  pUM3      = Sample[origin == "primary" & location %in% LOC3],
  smut      = Sample[secondary_mutation %in% CALLED],
  smut_pUM  = Sample[origin == "primary" & secondary_mutation %in% CALLED],
  chor      = Sample[origin == "primary" & location == "choroid"],
  chor_smut = Sample[origin == "primary" & location == "choroid" & secondary_mutation %in% CALLED],
  chor_pmut = Sample[origin == "primary" & location == "choroid" & primary_mutation %in% DRIVERS],
  chor_age  = Sample[origin == "primary" & location == "choroid" & !is.na(age_group)],
  pmut      = Sample[primary_mutation %in% DRIVERS],
  pmut_pUM  = Sample[origin == "primary" & primary_mutation %in% DRIVERS],
  organ     = Sample[organ %in% names(which(table(organ) >= 2))],   # thyroid (one sample) left out
  age       = Sample[!is.na(age_group)],
  age_pUM   = Sample[origin == "primary" & !is.na(age_group)],
  age_pt    = Sample[!is.na(age_group_pt)]
))

# ANOSIM, seeded per call so each p is reproducible on its own.
anosim_Rp <- function(d, g) {
  set.seed(42)
  a <- vegan::anosim(as.dist(d), g, permutations = N_PERM)
  c(R = unname(a$statistic), p = a$signif)
}
# Each test also once with one sample per patient per group (1/pt, the library with most cells kept).
run_test <- function(key, grouping, cell_set, mat, set, group, min_mel) {
  D <- if (mat == "all") D_all else D_mel
  ok <- sm$Sample[sm$Sample %in% sets[[set]] &
                    (mat != "mel" | sm$n_mel >= min_mel) & (mat != "mal" | sm$origin != "non-malignant")]
  s <- rownames(D)[rownames(D) %in% ok]   # matrix order: the permutation p depends on it
  g <- sm[[group]][match(s, sm$Sample)]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(g), length(unique(g)) >= 2)
  a <- anosim_Rp(D[s, s], g)
  b <- tibble(Sample = s, g = g, n = sm$n_cells[match(s, sm$Sample)], pt = sm$Patient_nr[match(s, sm$Sample)]) %>%
    group_by(pt, g) %>% slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
  b_res <- anosim_Rp(D[b$Sample, b$Sample], b$g)
  tab <- table(as.character(g))
  tibble(key = key, grouping = grouping, cell_set = cell_set,
         groups = paste(sprintf("%s %d", names(tab), tab), collapse = ", "),
         n_samples = length(s), n_patients = n_distinct(b$pt), R = a[["R"]], p = a[["p"]],
         n_samples_1pt = nrow(b), R_1pt = b_res[["R"]], p_1pt = b_res[["p"]])
}
res <- purrr::pmap_dfr(spec, run_test)

panel_of <- c(origin_all = "Fig1h; Fig1i; SFig3b", smut_pUM_called = "Fig1h; Fig1j", loc_pUM = "Fig1h; Fig1k",
              organ_all = "Fig1h; SFig3c", pmut_all = "Fig1h; SFig3d")
res$panel <- dplyr::coalesce(panel_of[res$key], "Fig1h")
write_csv(res, "tables/Fig1h_anosim_tests.csv")
R_ <- function(k) res[res$key == k, ]
```

```{r helpers}
stars <- function(p) as.character(cut(p, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
fmt_p <- function(p) sprintf("p = %.3g", p)
wrap <- function(x, w = 100) paste(unlist(lapply(x, function(l) strwrap(l, w))), collapse = "\n")
anosim_lines <- function(k, what = "") {
  r <- R_(k)
  c(sprintf("ANOSIM%s: R = %.2f, %s", what, r$R, fmt_p(r$p)),
    if (r$n_samples_1pt < r$n_samples)
      sprintf("One sample per patient per group (n = %d): R = %.2f, %s", r$n_samples_1pt, r$R_1pt, fmt_p(r$p_1pt)))
}
pal_of <- list(origin = origin_colors[c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis")],
               secondary_mutation = second_mutations_col, location = primary_location_colors[LOC3],
               primary_mutation = primary_mutations_col, organ = organ_colors)
count_line <- function(s, col) {
  v <- as.character(sm[[col]][match(s, sm$Sample)])
  tab <- table(factor(v, levels = unique(c(names(pal_of[[col]]), v))))
  tab <- tab[tab > 0]
  sprintf("n = %d samples, %d patients (%s)", length(s), n_distinct(sm$Patient_nr[match(s, sm$Sample)]),
          paste(sprintf("%s %d", names(tab), tab), collapse = ", "))
}
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, device = cairo_pdf, width = w, height = h)
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  p
}
# Classical MDS (cmdscale) of the all-cells divergences of the plotted samples.
mds_plot <- function(s, colour, title, subtitle, legend_title, shape = NULL, label = FALSE) {
  xy <- cmdscale(as.dist(D_all[s, s]), k = 2)
  pal <- pal_of[[colour]]
  df <- tibble(Sample = s, MDS1 = xy[, 1], MDS2 = xy[, 2]) %>% left_join(sm, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(colour = factor(as.character(.data[[colour]]), levels = intersect(names(pal), as.character(.data[[colour]]))))
  stopifnot("level without a colour" = !anyNA(df$colour))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(MDS1, MDS2, colour = colour)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = legend_title) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.5, lineheight = 1.05),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14), axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
  if (is.null(shape)) return(p + geom_point(size = 6))
  p <- p + geom_point(aes(shape = .data[[shape]]), size = 6) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("non-malignant" = 16, "primary" = 17, "metastasis" = 18), name = "Origin") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 5), order = 2), shape = guide_legend(order = 1))
  if (label) p <- p + geom_text_repel(aes(label = samplename), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, point.size = 6,
                                      box.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0.2, seed = 1, show.legend = FALSE)
  p
}
prim <- sm$Sample[sm$origin == "primary"]
```

# {.tabset}

## Overview

**Purpose**: Quantify how different the samples of the atlas are from each other and test whether that difference
follows disease category, location, mutation status, organ, gender or age.

**Input**: the full atlas (`r nrow(sm)` samples, `r n_distinct(sm$Patient_nr)` patients,
`r format(nrow(cells), big.mark = ",")` cells), first 50 PCs of the non-integrated PCA.

**Method**: GloScope (k-NN density, k = 50, symmetric KL divergence between every pair of samples). Two divergence
matrices: all cells, and melanocytic cells (iCNV-malignant cells in tumours, melanocytes in non-malignant samples;
samples with fewer than 100 such cells are left out, 50 for the organ and gender rows). The malignant-cell tests use
the tumours of the melanocytic matrix. MDS = classical scaling (`cmdscale`) of the all-cells matrix.

**Test**: ANOSIM, 999 permutations, unit = sample. Each test is repeated with one sample per patient per group
(1/pt). p-values are not adjusted; 0.001 is the smallest possible p. Ciliochoroidal (one primary) is not a tested
location and is not drawn.

**Tables**: `tables/Fig1h_anosim_tests.csv` (one row per test, `panel` names the figure).

## Fig. 1h

ANOSIM R and significance for every grouping (rows) and cell set (columns).

```{r fig1h, fig.width=13, fig.height=13}
row_order <- c("Origin", "Non-malignant vs primary", "Secondary mutation (pUM)", "Secondary mutation (choroidal pUM)",
               "Secondary mutation", "Location", "Location (pUM)", "Location (non-malignant)",
               "Primary mutation", "Organ", "Gender", "Age")
col_order <- c(C_ALL, C_MAL, C_MEL, C_PRIM, C_MALP, C_CHOR)
hm <- res %>% mutate(label = paste0(sprintf("R=%.2f\n%s", R, stars(p)),
                                    ifelse(n_samples_1pt < n_samples, sprintf("\n1/pt: R=%.2f %s", R_1pt, stars(p_1pt)), "")))
grid_all <- expand_grid(grouping = row_order, cell_set = col_order) %>%
  left_join(hm, by = c("grouping", "cell_set")) %>%
  mutate(grouping = factor(grouping, levels = rev(row_order)), cell_set = factor(cell_set, levels = col_order))
cap_h <- wrap(c(
  "R = ANOSIM R on GloScope KL divergence between samples. *** p <= 0.001 (the floor with 999 permutations), ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, ns otherwise; unadjusted.",
  "1/pt = same test with one sample per patient per group (largest library kept), shown where it changes n.",
  "Melanocytic cells = healthy melanocytes in non-malignant samples; for tumours the melanocytic cells are the malignant cells.",
  "Primary Tumors = all cells of the 30 primaries; Malignant Cells, pUM = malignant cells of the primaries only; Choroidal pUM = all cells of the 18 choroidal primaries.",
  "The pUM rows of Malignant Cells are already primaries-only, so they equal the Malignant Cells, pUM column.",
  "Secondary mutation rows: BAP1 / SF3B1 / EIF1AX only. Secondary mutation and Location without a qualifier: every sample of that cell set.",
  "Location = sample location (eye sub-site, non-malignant eye sub-site, or metastatic site); the ciliochoroidal tumour is left out; thyroid (one sample) is kept.",
  "Age, Melanocytic Cells: non-malignant samples take their patient's age (in the other columns they have none and are left out).",
  "Grey = not applicable to that cell set, or not run."), 112)
p_h <- ggplot(grid_all, aes(cell_set, grouping)) +
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(grid_all, !is.na(R)), aes(fill = R), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(grid_all, is.na(R)), fill = "grey92", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(grid_all, !is.na(R)), aes(label = label), size = 3.2, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0.2, limits = c(-0.1, 0.6),
                       oob = scales::squish, name = "ANOSIM R") +
  labs(title = "GloScope ANOSIM Summary",
       subtitle = sprintf("R statistic and significance across cell subsets (%d samples, %d patients)",
                          nrow(sm), n_distinct(sm$Patient_nr)),
       caption = cap_h, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 30, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5, colour = "grey25"), plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 20))
save_fig(p_h, "Fig1h_gloscope_anosim_summary", 13, 13)
```

## Suppl. Fig. 3b-d

KL divergence between all samples (3b, clustered), MDS by organ with sample names (3c), MDS by primary driver
mutation (3d).

```{r sfig3b, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
a <- sm[match(rownames(D_all), sm$Sample), ]
fac <- function(x, lev) factor(x, levels = intersect(lev, x))
age_cols <- setNames(c(unname(ageGroup_col[c("Young", "Middle", "Old")]), "#E1E1E1FF"),
                     c("<40", "40-60", "≥60", "unknown"))
anno <- list(Patient = fac(a$Patient_nr, names(patient_cols)),
             Origin = fac(as.character(a$origin), c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis")),
             Organ = fac(a$organ, names(organ_colors)), Location = fac(a$location, names(location_colors)),
             Gender = fac(a$Gender, names(gender_col)),
             `Age group` = fac(coalesce(a$age_group_pt, "unknown"), names(age_cols)),
             `Primary mutation` = fac(a$primary_mutation, names(primary_mutations_col)),
             `Secondary mutation` = fac(a$secondary_mutation, names(second_mutations_col)))
cols <- list(Patient = patient_cols, Origin = origin_colors, Organ = organ_colors, Location = location_colors,
             Gender = gender_col, `Age group` = age_cols, `Primary mutation` = primary_mutations_col,
             `Secondary mutation` = second_mutations_col)
cols <- Map(function(x, cl) cl[levels(x)], anno, cols[names(anno)])
stopifnot("annotation value without a colour" = !any(vapply(anno, anyNA, logical(1))))
oa <- R_("origin_all")
make_ht <- function() Heatmap(
  D_all, name = "KL divergence",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, median(D_all), max(D_all)), c("white", "orange", "red")),
  top_annotation = do.call(HeatmapAnnotation, c(anno, list(col = cols, annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                                                          show_legend = c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, length(anno) - 1))))),
  show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_title = sprintf("GloScope Divergence (All Cells, %d samples, %d patients)\nOrigin ANOSIM: R = %.2f, %s; one sample per patient per group: R = %.2f, %s",
                         nrow(D_all), n_distinct(a$Patient_nr), oa$R, fmt_p(oa$p), oa$R_1pt, fmt_p(oa$p_1pt)),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "KL divergence", legend_height = unit(4, "cm")))
png("figures/SFig3b_kl_heatmap.png", width = 14, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(make_ht(), padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 15), "mm")); invisible(dev.off())
cairo_pdf("figures/SFig3b_kl_heatmap.pdf", width = 14, height = 12)
draw(make_ht(), padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 15), "mm")); invisible(dev.off())
draw(make_ht(), padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 15), "mm"))
```
